transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we need to complete our annual emergency evacuation exercise during the fall term, and I'll be giving final approval to the plan. The draft currently calls for a standard evacuation alarm, assembly in the east courtyard, and a general family notice. Before I can approve it, school policy requires me to review the plan with the nurse, counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison. I'd like to go through the draft with all of you and hear any concerns or suggestions before I sign off. Shall we begin?
